/answer [auto-answered-by-orchestrator]

Auto-answered by the orchestrator clarify-respond workflow.

DECISIONS:
Q1: A
Q2: A
Q3: A

RATIONALE:
Q1: A recurring, bounded backfill reuses the existing `autofix_failure` report path (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh`, which already takes `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_REASON` and `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_MARKER_AUTHOR` for the identical-failure cap). It runs on a schedule that already exists, so it adds no new script for an operator to run. A one-time catch-up (B) would only cover this one historical failure and would need an entry in the removal registry. C does not answer the activation finding, which asks for an automated reporter.
Q2: #6756 decided on purpose that `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS` get one diagnosis comment, the `ai:needs-human` label and a WARNING instead of a heal issue (`scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:523-593`), and PR #7065 kept the resolver's fail-closed path policy. That diagnosis comment is the successor. Filing heal issues for these reasons (B/C) would bring back the loop #6756 removed, and a heal cannot fix a path the sandbox refuses by policy.
Q3: Only markers written by the trusted `GH_PAT` account, on the PR's current head, can name a run without letting PR comment text forge a report. The intake's existing provenance gate then re-checks the run's repository, failed status, workflow path and PR link before it reads any logs. B would report failures nobody marked, which the intake would refuse anyway. C needs run IDs the repository does not record, which breaks the data-provision guard.

EXECUTION PLAN (required for any non-letter decision):
Q1:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh (the reporter: `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_REASON`, `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_MARKER_AUTHOR`, `PR_PAYLOAD_FILE`, `PR_ISSUE_COMMENTS_FILE`, `REPORT_WRAPPER_SHA`; it always exits 0)
    - scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py (`NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS`, the marker parsing used by `count_identical_failures`, `build-autofix-payload`)
    - scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:523-593 (non-retryable routing, pr/head/reason dedup, `ai:needs-human`)
    - .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml (`*/30` schedule, open-PR enumeration in this repo)
    - workflow-templates/ai-review.yml (hourly consumer schedule jobs, e.g. `provider-outage-resume` / `security-hold-sweep`); the historical failure is in a consumer repo (drhyg_ecommerce_automation#66), so the consumer schedule must run the pass too
  steps:
    - Add a step "Backfill non-retryable autofix failure reports" to the existing sweep job in review_autofix_sweep.yml. Add the same pass to the existing hourly schedule path of workflow-templates/ai-review.yml (and its reusable-workflow counterpart if the job body lives there). Do not add a new workflow file or cron.
    - Gate it on the new env `WORKFLOW_HEAL_NON_RETRYABLE_BACKFILL_ENABLED`, default on. Unset, empty or `true` keep it on, `false` turns it off, and any other value turns it off with a `::warning::`. The helper sets this default itself (§8). Also skip when `WORKFLOW_HEAL_ENABLED=false`.
    - Bound each tick with `WORKFLOW_HEAL_NON_RETRYABLE_BACKFILL_MAX_PER_TICK` (default 3; an invalid value warns and falls back to 3). Read PR comments from the snapshots the sweep already fetches, or with one paginated comments read per candidate PR. Add no per-PR call inside an existing cached loop (§14).
    - For each candidate, select the run as described in Q3. Then call workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh with `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_REASON=<marker reason>`, `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_MARKER_AUTHOR=<GH_PAT login>`, `AUTOFIX_FAILURE_FP=<marker fp>`, the PR JSON/comments files, and `REPORT_RUN_URL` pointing at the marker's run. That way run_refs name the historical failed run, and the intake verifies it as usual.
    - Log `WORKFLOW_HEAL_NON_RETRYABLE_BACKFILL pr= head= reason= run= outcome=dispatched|skip|failed reason=`. Register the new prefix in an `agents.d/<issue>-non-retryable-backfill.md` fragment (§25), together with a changelog.d fragment. Every failure stays fail-open: the sweep step never fails.
    - Tests: a fake-`gh` test of the pass covering the off switch, the per-tick cap, an untrusted marker author (skip), an already-diagnosed pr/head/reason (skip), and one eligible marker (exactly one dispatch carrying the marker's run).
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: none
  equivalence_argument: Every failure is still reported live. The backfill only re-sends failures a trusted marker records that never got a diagnosis, such as runs from before #6756 or a lost dispatch. So the historical failure gets its successor automatically.
  reversibility: Set `WORKFLOW_HEAL_NON_RETRYABLE_BACKFILL_ENABLED=false`, or remove the step. The intake's dedup marker makes any re-sent report a no-op.
Q2:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:523-593
  steps:
    - Leave the intake's non-retryable routing, `WORKFLOW_HEAL_NON_RETRYABLE_ROUTING_ENABLED`, the pre-filing scope-marker check and the resolver path policy unchanged. Add no exception for backfilled reports.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: "If a successor issue is still required, add a narrowly scoped routing exception": the successor is the `ai:workflow-heal-non-retryable:v1` diagnosis plus `ai:needs-human`, not a heal issue.
  equivalence_argument: An operator gets an automatic, provenance-verified signal on the PR with the remediation text (manual merge, or fix workflow support), which is the intent of a successor. A heal issue cannot change a fail-closed sandbox path policy.
  reversibility: A later issue can add the Q2-B exception behind its own switch. This change does not block that.
Q3:
  strategy: derive_from_repo
  inputs:
    - `review-autofix-failure:v1` markers (head, reason, fp, support, run) and `ai:workflow-heal-non-retryable:v1 pr= head= reason=` markers
  steps:
    - Trust only comments whose author is the `GH_PAT` login, read once per tick with `gh api user`. If identity is unavailable, skip the tick. Skip provider-outage markers and comments, as `count_identical_failures` does.
    - Take the newest trusted failure marker for the PR's current head SHA. Continue only if its reason is in `NON_RETRYABLE_FAILURE_REASONS` and no trusted `ai:workflow-heal-non-retryable:v1` marker exists for the same pr/head/reason.
    - Dispatch only the run that marker names. Run verification stays with the intake's existing provenance gate, and a rejected report logs `WORKFLOW_HEAL provenance_rejected` there as today.
  replaces_acceptance_criterion: none
  equivalence_argument: Run metadata is "obtained and verified" from trusted markers and checked again by the intake, so text from an untrusted PR cannot name a run.
  reversibility: The off switch disables the pass. Widening the selection later (B) is an additive change.
